data.narrative:
Loft Orbital is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $326M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, with direct stage-and-sector comparables including Sierra Space ($8.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B), and Skyryse ($1.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x multiplier to the $326M total raised as a valuation proxy, implying $554M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage, same-sector comparables yields a median of $1.5B, though with material dispersion: the range spans $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 23.9x across 6 tickers) cannot be applied, as target revenue is not publicly available. 

The two applicable methods support a triangulated range of $471M to $1.7B, with a median of $1.0B. Key uncertainties include the wide valuation gap between the stage-progression floor ($554M) and peer median ($1.5B), reflecting both uncertainty about Loft Orbital's operational and market position relative to peers and the inherent dispersion within the Space & Aerospace sector. Revenue disclosure would enable public-comp calibration and narrow this range materially.
